video_title: My Recovery Update, DJing Journey | Time Out with Tyrese Haliburton | Episode 2

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton reflects on his one-year recovery and return to form
quotes.excerpt: I feel so good. I'm like playing five-on-five, doing hard workouts every day. I'm back.
quotes.quote: This week is week 52. This is my one year. Man, I feel so good. I'm playing five-on-five, doing hard workouts every day. I could pretty much say I'm back at this point. I feel like I'm in shape, but there's a difference between being in shape and being in game shape. I feel like I took a different thing. I like to play fast, so I got to get back to there, which will take some time.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on using video games as a mental release during the season
quotes.excerpt: For me in season, video games are big for me because during my game day, I like to get away.
quotes.quote: Most importantly, it's a mental release. For me in season, video games are big for me because during my game day, I like to get away, go play video games with my boys, just be away from basketball for a little bit before getting to war. So, I try to get my mind off, especially this year. I got to get my mind off of this injury and this season. That was good for me to pick up a new skill and learn that.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton discusses how his hobbies helped him through his recovery process
quotes.excerpt: I think all my hobbies help keep my sanity during rehab. It's been a long process.
quotes.quote: I think all my hobbies help keep my sanity during rehab. It's been a long process. Now I'm getting to playing five-on-five, running, and doing a little bit of everything. I'm kind of back to myself a little bit more in the basketball world, so that keeps me a little busy. But these things have definitely helped me get through DJing, gaming, everything is kind of helped me get through this time.
